# PR — 326_R7UX.3 — Files panel: hierarchy, icons, hover affordances (BL-94)

PR: [#420](https://github.com/SteveVitali/Rhema/pull/420)
Base: `stevenvitali/r7ux-2-timeline-polish` · Head: `stevenvitali/r7ux-3-files-panel-polish` @ `1959db52`
mergePolicy: OPERATOR (stacks bottom-up)

## Summary

- `packages/ui/src/files-pane.tsx` — each `data-file-row` is now a single
  `.ui-t-frow` flex line (fs-dense, radius-2, padded): kind icon under the new
  `data-kind-icon` hook, label, inline meta (`v{n}` · words), and the lock `Badge`
  ONLY where a lock is meaningful (`lock !== "editable"` — frozen/immutable/inspect;
  ordinary working drafts show none; demo/read-only `editMode:"none"` rows are
  immutable ⇒ still badged). Provenance collapses from a per-row block line to a
  right-aligned truncated `ui-t-frow-prov` span on the same line (run link kept),
  with the full text also on the anchor `title`; the freshness note wraps to a
  `ui-t-frow-sub` line. Same rows, same hrefs, same treeitem/keyboard contract —
  presentation only.
- `packages/ui/src/ui-tail-css.ts` — the `.ui-t-frow*` rules: flex-wrap line at the
  dense step, `:hover`/`:focus-within` `shell-raised` background + link underline
  (the clickability affordance), truncating provenance, `flex-basis:100%` sub-line.
  `uiCss()` is at its REQ-KIT-5 bound (24,567/24,576 B) — the tail block carries
  them (→5,093/5,120 B).
- `apps/web/src/dom-contract.ts` — `data-kind-icon` declared; `data-lock-badge`
  + `data-provenance` files-tree entries updated to the new semantics.
- `packages/ui/src/files-pane.test.tsx` — +176 lines: badge gate matrix, collapsed
  provenance (no `display:block`; in-line carrier; title hook; run link), per-kind
  icon hooks, the interactive class + shipped CSS rules, treeitem/roving-tabindex
  + freshness sub-line.

## Acceptance → evidence

- Lock glyph absent on an ordinary draft, present on read-only/demo rows →
  `files-pane.test.tsx` first test (d1 no badge; d2/m1 immutable + s1 inspect
  badged). Edge: `persona_seed` is `readOnly`+`editable` — no badge (truthful:
  the artifact is user-editable; `data-readonly` + sr-only note still mark it).
- Provenance collapsed → second test: `ui-t-frow-prov` in-line span (ellipsis),
  `title` on the treeitem anchor + the span, `data-run` + `href` preserved.
- Icons per kind asserted by hook → third test (`data-kind-icon` ×6).
- Hover affordance via `ui-*` class → fourth test (`ui-t-frow` on rows;
  `uiTailCss()` ships the `:hover`/`:focus-within` rules).
- ReadOnlyProject/demo guards → presentation-only diff; guards untouched.
- Out of scope held → no tree behavior, new kinds, or editor integration.
